```{r}
library(tidyverse)
#Create data frame
logged_data <- read_csv("E:/Study/stats220/Project2/Survey On Shows Watching.csv") %>% 
  rename(Timestamp = 1, 
         Show_Watching_Frequency = 2, 
         Average_Hours_Watched = 3, 
         watching_time = 4, 
         Preferred_Device = 5, 
         Recent_Content_Type = 6, 
         Preferred_Platform_Reason = 7)
latest_data <- logged_data
```

## Plot one & Summary

```{r}
#Plot 1
ggplot(data = latest_data) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = Average_Hours_Watched), fill = "#40E0D0") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Average Hours Watched",
    x = "Average Hours Watched",
    y = "Hours per day"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#daf5f2"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 1)
  )

#Summary data 1
max_Hours = max(latest_data$Average_Hours_Watched)
min_Hours = min(latest_data$Average_Hours_Watched)
mean_Hours = mean(latest_data$Average_Hours_Watched)

#Summary 1
paste("The maximum average time of show watched is", max_Hours,"hours per day.", 
      "The minimum average time of show watched is", min_Hours,"hours per day.", 
      "The mean average time of show watched is", mean_Hours, "hours per day.")
```

## Plot two & Summary

```{r}
#Plot 2
ggplot(data = latest_data) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = watching_time), fill = "#40E0D0") +
  labs(
    title = "When do people usually watch shows",
    x = "watching time",
    y = "Number of responses"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#daf5f2"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

#Summary data 2
Number_of_responses = table(latest_data$watching_time)
most_used = names(which.max(Number_of_responses))
most_used_c = max(Number_of_responses)
least_used = names(which.min(Number_of_responses))
least_used_c = min(Number_of_responses)

#Summary 2
paste0("The most people prefer to watch shows in the ", most_used, ", used by ", most_used_c, " people. \n",
       "The least people prefer to watch shows in the ", least_used, ", used by ", least_used_c, " people.")
```
